reviews.comment: Do not recommend. The entire course is based on 3 exams that are worth most of your grade and are only 25 questions making the grade fluctuate heavily. There will be a group presentation once a week so that he only has to lecture once a week. He will not work with you for scheduling conflicts and does not reply quickly to emails. Very boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy
